trades.name: Hold or (better) LBAF of 6866-6869
trades.quote: Long a hold or (better) LBAF of 6866-6869. There is some demand sitting just below which I would expect to at least be initially reactive unless we gap through it on Sunday night. This would need to clear the 77-80 range to comfortably have range but if so would target 6891.25, 6895.5, and the weekly 6900-6902.5 range. Monitor for continuation from there. I see the hold as an A- and the LBAF as an A+. The LBAF could come from the below setup as well.
trades.stop_hint: This would need to clear the 77-80 range to comfortably have range

trades.name: LBAF of 6857 (Thursday's spike base)
trades.quote: Long a LBAF of 6857 which was Thursday’s spike base. There is demand just below here as well, call it 6852 (10/30 low of day) +/- 3 handles which protects Friday’s low. This would represent a deep retest of Friday’s low but expect buyers to be active on an initial test. This one is perhaps lower probability than the above as both 66-69 and 77-80 would need to reclaim, but obviously the R is higher. I’m therefore still willing to rate it an A/A-
trades.stop_hint: demand just below here as well, call it 6852 (10/30 low of day) +/- 3 handles which protects Friday’s low; both 66-69 and 77-80 would need to reclaim

trades.name: LBAF of Friday's low
trades.quote: Long a LBAF of Friday’s low. The gap to the 10/24 high was not properly filled, and that day’s VAH (6839.25) sits just below. Until sellers find traction down through this range, I will be looking for the LBAF of Friday’s low. This would be a LBAF of a daily low, a LBAF of a weekly low, and represent a gap fill reversal. It would still need to reclaim 66-69 minimum but if so, it has potential to produce a bullish engulfing week. Depending on what NQ is doing this could come from lower but I can’t plan on buying a dip in the middle of the 10/24 range without seeing it in real time. Keep in mind a strong rating doesn’t mean that it WILL happen, but it means the reward to risk and probability of producing extreme range is such that it can’t be ignored. This is an A+ setup and one of the best I’ve seen in some time while planning ahead of time.
trades.stop_hint: It would still need to reclaim 66-69 minimum

trades.name: LAAF of 6895.5 and/or Friday's high
trades.quote: Short a LAAF 6895.5 and/or Friday’s high. This could play as a LAAF of Friday’s high as well that then gets trapped back below 6895.5, or a LAAF of 95.5 which doesn’t clear Friday’s high. I am more likely to take this if we trade higher first from 66-69 as it is somewhat harder for me to want to short if sellers have already flopped. Once below 6891 this would target 77-80 and 66-69. Monitor for continuation from there. This is perhaps less clean than the longs but still a B/B+ rating.

trades.quote: Long a hold or LBAF of 25948-25969 targeting 26055-26069 but I would watch for a response as low as 25035 to start taking profit if indicated. If 055-069 is reclaimed I would target 26095 and 26128-26141, monitoring for continuation from there. This is an A/A- setup
